project_name: Knowledge Engine - MOOD for DESIGN Blueprint Chameleon™

primary_heading.usage: Page Titles, Brand Names, Feature Headlines, Empty State messages

eyebrow_and_meta.usage: Overlines (MOOD AI · KNOWLEDGE ENGINE™), Labels, Meta Stats (Category, Country, Pages, %)

PageHeader.visuals: Ambient corner glow (radial gradient from top-left using accent_glow)
PageHeader.title: Serif, text-4xl to text-5xl

Toolbar.search: Dark input with Search icon. On focus: glow cyan (ring/border accent)

NewBrandCard.closed_state: Dark card with subtle accent glow, inviting interaction
NewBrandCard.open_state: Expands into an elegant form. Monospace uppercase labels. am-input styling. Footer with Atelier pill CTA

BrandGroup.header: Flex row, Serif Brand Name (22-26px), Monospace meta (Category · Country). Hairline divider below.

CatalogSetRow.layout: Flex row, PDF icon, Serif title for the catalog, Meta details in Monospace (Pages, % extracted).
CatalogSetRow.interaction: Hover: translate-x by 4px, background transition to soft border color, accent color on title or icon.
CatalogSetRow.status_badge: Atelier-pill format. Semantic text color and 10-15% opacity background via color-mix. Replace generic tone classes.

States.empty: Large centered layout, stylized minimal icon, elegant Serif phrase, 'Crea il primo brand' Atelier pill CTA
States.loading: Dark skeleton block with fluid shimmer effect (no plain 'Loading...' text)

animations.lists: Staggered fade-in (e.g., animation-delay step 50ms) for catalog sets
animations.hover_effects: Subtle transform (translate-x 4px) + glow manifestation on rows

instructions_to_main_agent: REWRITE /app/frontend/src/pages/inspirations/knowledge-engine.css completely (update/replace .ke- classes with new design language).
MANDATORY: Preserve ALL existing `data-testid` attributes exactly as they are.
MANDATORY: Preserve ALL API integration (KE.listBrands, KE.createBrand, KE.listCatalogSets, KE.createCatalogSet) and their logic states.
MANDATORY: Preserve Routing - click on CatalogSetRow must navigate to /inspirations/knowledge-engine/catalog-sets/${setId}.
MANDATORY: Implement the exact visual language defined in the 'MOOD for DESIGN Blueprint Chameleon™' - Serif headings, monospace eyebrows, dark luxury surface, cyan ambient glow.
RECOMMENDATION: Create local helper sub-components in the file if needed to keep the JSX clean (e.g., <AtelierStatBadge>, <AtelierSection>).
